README: Golden vectors for the Phase 1 deterministic technical engine.
'reference' was produced by TA-Lib in a throwaway virtual environment and
frozen here. TA-Lib is NOT a project dependency and does not run during
tests - only these numbers do. Regenerate with the scripts described in
docs/technical_conventions.md if the conventions ever change.
'ours' is this project's output, kept as a regression baseline. For every
indicator except MACD and the directional family it equals 'reference' to
floating-point noise. Those two differ by initialization only; see

known_differences.macd: TA-Lib starts the fast EMA at index (slow - fast) so both EMAs are seeded over the same number of bars. We seed each EMA independently from the start of the data, which is the textbook definition of 'EMA(12) - EMA(26)'. Applying TA-Lib's alignment to our EMA reproduces its output exactly, so the mathematics agrees and only the seed differs.
known_differences.directional: TA-Lib seeds the +DM / -DM / TR smoothing with the sum of the first period - 1 bars, decays it once, then adds the period-th bar. Wilder's published method - and TA-Lib's own ATR - seed with the sum of the first period bars. We follow Wilder, which also keeps our ADX consistent with our ATR.
